title.narrative: Support to engagement with US private sector

description.narrative: Engagement with the private sector for resource mobilization and partnership development is a core deliverable of UNESCO's Programme. The U.S. private sector, including American businesses and foundations, continues to rank as the leading private contributor to UNESCO. Continued engagement with U.S. private stakeholders is essential to securing strategic partnerships to advance the Organization's priorities. The need to sustain these efforts will become more important in light of the United States' decision to withdraw from the Organization. To maintain the momentum and further strengthen strategic private sector partnership in the US mobilizations efforts, a partnership mobilization consultant will be engaged in the New York Office.
